reports.text:
I played every day this week, and honestly it felt a bit too hard. Out of 95 cards I got 42 right, and the written ones hurt most: sentence translation was 0 of 5, typed translation 2 of 7, and cloze typed 2 of 6. Letter tiles were rough too. Typed meaning went better, and I can listen fine, so recognizing words is easier than producing them.

The good part is that words did come back: сказать, правда, должен, сегодня and others returned after 2 days, and хочешь, давай, конечно and лучше after 1 day. No word repeated within a session, so it never felt like the same card again and again.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that no card asked about: можешь, сюда, порядке, день, делать, after. Those never came back. Also, 4 cards didn't match any saved word.

This week felt a bit too hard for me. I played all 7 days across 9 sessions and got 47 right out of 90 cards. Choice cards were kind to me, like cloze choice and multiple choice, and the two sentence translations went well. Typing was rough. Letter tiles and typed translation were shaky, and both cloze typed cards were wrong.

Nothing repeated inside a session, so I never felt drilled on the same word. Some words did return later, like много after 8 days and всего after 6, and a few came back just in time, like сказать and тут after 3 days.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that never came back: можешь, сюда, всегда, день, делать, после, потом, такой, and even боже, сэр and мистер. I saved 22 new words, but 6 cards couldn't be matched to any of them.

This week felt a bit too hard for me. I played all 7 days, and I got 66 right out of 120 cards, so I was wrong a lot. Multiple choice (7 of 19) and matching (11 of 28) were the worst. Typed meaning went better, 34 of 53, and the small ones like reverse choice and cloze typed felt fine, but there were so few of them.

I never saw the same word twice in one session, so nothing felt repetitive. Old words did return, though. никогда came back after 10 days, точно after 8, and слишком and сказать after 7. That gap was long, and I had to guess.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that no card asked: можешь, сюда, сделать, всегда, дело, порядке, день, делать, после, боже, сэр, мистер. They never came back. Also, 6 cards didn't match any word I saved.
